headline: Coordinate Separate Maryland State and National Park Entry
reservation: Assateague Island is divided into a Maryland State Park and a National Seashore, each requiring separate entry fees and camping reservations. Beach parking fills early during summer months, and reservations do not guarantee a specific space if you leave and return. Verify current booking windows on the official Recreation.gov and Maryland DNR sites.

stops.name: North Beach

intel.title: Beach Lot Capacity
intel.text: Parking at the North Beach and State Park areas often reaches capacity by mid-morning in summer. Arrive early to secure a spot within walking distance of the Atlantic.

intel.title: Island Dead Zones
intel.text: Cellular reception is generally available near the bridge but fades quickly in the southern dunes. Do not rely on digital navigation for remote sections of the Over-Sand Vehicle zones.

intel.title: Mainland Supply Only
intel.text: There are no fuel stations located on Assateague Island itself. Fill your tank in Berlin or West Ocean City before crossing the Verrazzano Bridge.

intel.title: Insect Activity Windows
intel.text: Biting flies and mosquitoes are most active near the marshes during warm, calm summer days. Coastal breezes on the ocean-facing beaches can offer some relief.

intel.title: Maryland-Virginia Separation
intel.text: There is no public road connecting the Maryland and Virginia ends of the island. Travelers must drive back to the mainland to reach Chincoteague, which takes over an hour.

plan.arrival: Fly into SBY and drive through Berlin to stock up on beach supplies and groceries. Check into your mainland lodging before heading to the island bridge.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are fine for paved park roads, but Over-Sand Vehicle (OSV) zones require a specific permit and 4WD equipment.
plan.goldenHour: The Life of the Marsh boardwalk offers expansive sunset views over Sinepuxent Bay, subject to seasonal gate closures.
